SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.City = 'Los Angeles'
AND frpm.Free_Meal_Count_K_12 > 500
AND frpm.Free_Meal_Count_K_12 < 700;
